data.data:
Dear Endministrator,

Recruitment for Arknights: Endfield PlayStation®5 Technical Test has officially started! Fill out the recruitment survey to apply for this round of testing. You'll find the key info and FAQs for this test below:


▼// Recruitment Survey

Complete the recruitment survey for a chance to join PlayStation®5 Technical Test.

Survey link: https://survey.gryphline.com/s/836757b2624e8632b10f22ef28339a4c


▼// Recruitment Period

2025-10-31 (UTC-5) – 2025-11-17 at 05:00 (UTC-5)


▼// Test Overview

Platforms: Platforms: PlayStation®5 / PlayStation®5 Pro

Test Type: Limited-access, free of charge, data-wipe test

Period: Start and end dates to be announced

Game Languages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Russian

Voice Languages: Mandarin, English, Japanese, Korean
